# P35.20a — Per-dossier provenance + unclamped, exclusion-disclosed coverage

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/300_P35.20a__per-dossier-provenance-unclamped-coverage.md`
(manifest row **300**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B — the **a-half** of the
PKG-10 public-number corrections: fix the misleading public provenance and
coverage numbers *before* the next export; the b-half owns freshness +
map-table suppression). Invoked `live_verification=false` — committed code
only; **no export run, no republish, no production mutation** — the
corrected numbers arrive with the next export/release under that row's own
authority. **Requirement ids stamped:** this row owns **F-134** (the
coverage-numerator clamp), closing **ED-41** + **ED-42**; cited
**SIG-METRIC-009/003/006/008**, **SIG-UI-008/044**, **SIG-RECON-058**.
**Base:** `r11/P35.19-placement-engine` · **Gate:** none ·
**Production mutations:** none — an export/inference-path correction only.

## The defects

- **ED-41 (F-05/F-132/C3 NEW-3/NEW-13).** Every `/dossier/<slug>/` page
  rendered the same site-wide "How we know this" — "218 independent
  sources", "Artifacts 255" — under the dossier's own heading, though the
  dossier's Sources rows named 1–4 sources. The site totals were silently
  substituted for the dossier's own evidence set.
- **ED-42 (F-134/F-134's trace rows C3-T032/T033/T184/T185 + C3-T037–T040).**
  Every per-predicate reconciliation ratio read **"N of N"** —
  "232,625 of 232,625 subjects with a resolved camera_latitude value" —
  while the public surface itself showed 5,290 of those subjects
  `point_status=conflicted` (no point published; the dossier gap says
  "conflicting coordinate evidence … no resolution is defensible"). The
  numerator counted *any* resolution row with a `winning_claim` set — no
  tier-0/currency/publication filter — then `min(resolved, claimed)`
  clamped it to the denominator, so an over-count read as a clean 100%.

## What ships

- **`inference/materialize.py` — the unclamped, exclusion-aware ratio.**
  `read_predicate_reconciliation` recomputes the numerator **by join**
  over the denominator population: a claimed subject enters the numerator
  only when a CURRENT envelope (`upper_inf(r.sys_period)` — the
  superseded-decision filter the old numerator lacked) picked a winning
  claim that is tier-0 AND currently-valid AND publication-eligible (the
  shared `db.dispositions.claim_eligible_sql` fragment, degraded to `true`
  on a pre-disposition-registry spine). Every other claimed subject lands
  in exactly one disclosed class — **`conflicted`** (a current envelope,
  no defensible winner — F-134's "5,290 withheld"), **`withheld`** (the
  winner fails the publication-disposition gate), **`non_publishable`**
  (the winner is eligible but non-tier-0 or lapsed), **`filtered`** (no
  current envelope at all). `min(resolved, claimed)` is gone; the function
  asserts `resolved + Σexcluded = claimed` on every row, and the numerator
  is a subset of the denominator by construction (GQ-16).
- **`coverage_exclusion_disclosure` — a new additive sqitch change.**
  `exclusions jsonb` on `coverage_record` carries the per-class disclosure
  *as data on the measured row*, and the `coverage_ratio_exclusions_sum`
  CHECK pins `numerator + not_evaluable = denominator` on every
  **disclosing** ratio row — an "N of N" beside excluded subjects cannot
  be inserted, not even by hand. Pre-P35.20a rows (`exclusions IS NULL`)
  are untouched; the deploy never re-adjudicates history.
- **The disclosure rides the whole pipeline.** `metric_row` digests the
  exclusion map (a changed exclusion set is a superseding append-only
  measurement, never an UPDATE), `_insert_coverage` persists it,
  `read_materialized_coverage` round-trips it with an information_schema
  back-compat probe, and `coverage_metric_from_materialized` emits
  `exclusions` + `excluded_total` on the web `CoverageMetric` — the public
  surface can now say "227,335 of 232,625 (5,290 excluded: conflicted)"
  instead of a false "232,625 of 232,625". `CoverageMetric` gains the two
  optional fields; the frozen P27.1 contract schema + companion doc gain
  them additively (optional, never a relaxation of the never-a-total
  invariants).
- **Per-dossier provenance (`exports/analytics.py`).** `surfaces.dossiers`
  is a new map keyed by the same `jurisdiction_slug(group.jurisdiction)`
  the dossier surface uses — each dossier gets a complete SIG-UI-044
  summary counted over ITS OWN evidence set: the publishable weight rows
  whose `claim_id` backs a site in that jurisdiction bucket, the distinct
  artifacts bound to those claims, the dossier's own source-independence
  count, date range, ruleset, and a `denominator` naming the dossier's
  scope. `human_review_status` is honestly `unreviewed` per dossier —
  the site-level verdict pairs don't name subjects, so a dossier never
  inherits a review posture it hasn't earned. Derivation + emitted rows
  are this row; the dossier contribution export and the final "How we
  know this" presentation remain the **DSRC-01/P35.44 seam** (recorded).
- **The honest fallback (`web/`).** `getDossierProvenance(slug)` reads the
  emitted row for the dossier's slug — `undefined` when none was emitted
  (a pre-change export, a non-jurisdiction surface, or fixtures mode).
  `/dossier/[slug]` passes it through `BaseLayout`, which renders the
  page-scoped module *named for the dossier* when a row exists and the
  site-wide module *explicitly labelled "Site-wide"* when it does not —
  site totals can never carry a surface's name, because the scope label
  always names the data actually counted. The fixture-export harness
  emits a per-dossier row for each fixture dossier so the e2e seam
  renders the same shape.

## Tests (fails-if-removed)

- `tests/inference/test_materialize_coverage.py` — **+3**: the fixed
  exclusion-class vocabulary; the disclosure rides `metric_row` + digest;
  a canned-spine reconciliation proving the numerator counts only
  resolved-publishable subjects and every excluded class discloses
  exactly (`resolved + Σexcluded = claimed`, never a clamp).
- `tests/db/test_coverage_materialize.py` — **+5** over real PG18+PostGIS:
  excluded subjects disclosed (conflicted envelope → `conflicted:1`,
  numerator 1-of-2, never clamped); a disposition-withheld winning claim
  disclosed as `withheld`; numerator ⊆ denominator by join (a resolved
  envelope for a subject with no claim changes nothing); the DB CHECK
  refuses a non-reconciling disclosing ratio and accepts the honest row;
  a legacy `exclusions IS NULL` row still satisfies the constraint.
- `tests/exports/test_export_analytics.py` — the surface set now includes
  `dossiers`; a two-jurisdiction export proves each dossier row counts
  only its own claims' sources/tiers, is keyed by the rendered dossier's
  slug, carries all six SIG-UI-044 components + its own denominator, and
  can never equal the site row when scopes differ.
- `tests/exports/test_spine_export.py` — **+1**: a materialized ratio's
  exclusions + `excluded_total` reach `web/coverage.json` and satisfy the
  frozen contract schema.
- `web/tests/unit/data.test.ts` — **+4**: an emitted dossier row returns
  scoped; an unemitted slug → `undefined` (the honest site-wide fallback,
  never site totals under the dossier's name); a pre-change export with
  no `dossiers` map falls back cleanly; fixtures mode always falls back.
- `tests/db/test_annotation_alignment.py` — `exclusions` registered on
  the `coverage_record` DDL↔value-object pair.
- `tests/db/test_spine_export_over_seeded_spine.py` — the seeded-spine
  provenance assertion extended to the four-surface shape.
- **`make check`**: ruff/format/mypy clean; pytest **9,234 passed**.
  Honest caveats — four environmental/inherited failures none of which
  this change touches: `test_secrets` needs the `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` needle
  env (OP-07, CI provides it), `test_p34_18_aliases` ×2 scan the
  operator-local restricted map and flag committed ancestor files
  (P34.39a records, untouched here), and `test_no_future_date_literals`
  judges the new sqitch plan stamp against pre-commit HEAD — it resolves
  the moment this commit lands (the stamp then predates HEAD).
- `check_live_claims corpus`: **0 violations** after phrasing the
  DEFERRALS note without live-state vocabulary.

## Number-trace re-derivation (oracle untouched)

`docs/build/planning/2026-09-30-next-phase/data/number_trace.csv` rows
C3-T032/T033/T184/T185 (camera_latitude/longitude) and C3-T037–T040
(roadway/status/type/citation) document the clamp defect: displayed
"N of N", recomputed "227,335 resolved public points; 5,290 conflicted".
Under this change the emitted metric reads `227,335 of 232,625` with
`excluded_total`/`exclusions.conflicted` beside it — matching the trace's
honest recomputation. **Named residual R-P35.20a-1:** the trace records
only the conflicted count (5,290); the withheld / non_publishable /
filtered splits cannot be re-derived without the live spine — they are
measured at the next materialization, disclosed on the rows, never
estimated here. The `.sig-hwkt` dossier rows (C3-T349/T359/T369, …) now
re-derive to per-dossier scoped summaries (or an explicitly labelled
site-wide fallback); per-dossier values are emitted by the next export.
